briefing.summary: Explore Hunga Tonga–Hunga Ha’apai before the January 2022 eruption. Scan the shallow caldera basin, then follow the volcanic slope beyond the rim.
facts: Before the 15 January 2022 eruption, Hunga’s central basin was about 150–200 m deep and roughly 4.5 km across.
The 2014–2015 eruption built a cone that joined the two older islands, Hunga Tonga and Hunga Ha’apai.
The January 2022 eruption deepened the basin to about 850 m and separated the islands. This dive follows the earlier landscape.
With a surface start, head west-southwest and descend toward the caldera floor.
hazards: Steep volcanic slopes: watch your altitude as you cross the rim.
Dim water along the deeper flank; use your lights to read the layered rock.
Pressure at the shallow basin floor is about 15–20 atmospheres.

objectives.title: Survey the pre-2022 caldera floor
objectives.hint: The caldera floor is the broad basin near 130 m, east of the inner wall.

objectives.title: Follow the volcanic rim slope
objectives.hint: The volcanic slope lies west of the shallow basin, near 470 m.
